notes.title: Update 1.23: New Graphics, Haptic Feedback, Gameplay Improvements, and a 50% Discount!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25282816/271a6cca1bdd7f1d18f9f81e3f7ec63eb079952b.jpg[/img]

Happy Lunar New Year! The weather might not be warming up, but we are with Snow Fortress 1.23! To celebrate, we have a 50% discount and a number of game updates for you: 
[list]
[*][b]Hardware Update: bHaptics Integration[/b] - Oof! If you use bHaptics devices, you can now feel snowball impacts to the face, body, and hands.
[*][b]Gameplay Update: Increased Hearts in Multiplayer PvP[/b] - Matches ended a little quickly in PvP, so we’ve increased lives from 3 to 5 hearts.
[*][b]Graphics Update: New Models and Animations[/b] - We added a fresh coat of paint to the game’s models and logo. Gotta look good for the new year!
[*][b]Graphics Update: Impact Feedback[/b] - Sometimes, it was hard to tell when you were hit, so we improved the visual feedback when struck by snowballs.
[*][b]Bug Fix: Oculus Controller Mapping Bug[/b]
[*][b]Bug Fix: Other Miscellaneous Bugs[/b]
[/list]
If you have faraway friends who want to play, but don’t own a VR headset, Snow Fortress can be found at SpringboardVR, VR Junkies, Ctrl V, MontVR, and Synthesis VR arcades around the world - with more locations coming soon! (Hint: Brazil, Finland, and South Korea are about to get frosty.)

As always, thank you for continuing to play with us! Have a great Lunar New Year and we hope you have lots of fun with the update!

Jeremy
Mythical City Games

notes.title: Update 1.1 Coop Multiplayer!
notes.notes:
It's been quite a while since we've updated Snow Fortress as a few other games have taken priority over the past year. So we've added a big new feature: Coop Multiplayer! 

So now, in addition to PVP you can team up together with a friend and face off the snowman army together!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25282816/0ea0ce70a819d56d68284a7732743201bed0d7c9.png[/img]

To get into a coop match, start multiplayer as usual and either find each other through your Steam friends list or Quick Match. Then once the level loads, select "COOP" from the settings panel (only the host can choose the settings). 

You can choose between 3 fort setups, allowing you to each have your own forts or share one fort together. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25282816/3a2a40f7d1980665e1586ffd47e2bdfbb28bd414.png[/img]

Wondering what other games we've been working on? Check out our VR city building game Skytropolis:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/629040/Skytropolis/

and our tank strategy game Battle Fleet: Ground Assault:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/400350/Battle_Fleet_Ground_Assault/

notes.title: Update 0.6 Released with Online Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Our latest update features something that everyone has been asking for since day one: Multiplayer! 

This is our first and very early beta release of the multiplayer features so expect some bugs and please let us know your feedback. The multiplayer offers just a simple 1v1 match against a random opponent or against your Steam friends. 

Select a game type (Quick Match or Find Friends) in the multiplayer menu and once you have 2 players each player has to pull their lever to set their ready state. 

To invite a friend, select them from the friends list in the multiplayer lobby menu and press their checkmark icon to send the invite. Your friend will need to have the game running and have the lobby menu open to receive the invite. To accept it they can do so from the Steam overlay dashboard while in VR (just press the system button on either controller to enter the Steam overlay). Once they accept the Steam invite they will join your match. 

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Update 0.53 Just Released
notes.notes:
We've got a new update for Snow Fortress ready for you guys! The 0.53 update address a few small issues and adds a system for making it more difficult to knock down your own fort blocks by accident when building.

- Blocks now weigh less when you are holding them so they won't knock over your other blocks as easily. This is something we plan on tweaking so let us know if you feel it still needs adjustment. 
- Adjusted snowball throwing in the snow fort mode so it matches survival mode which most people like better for the throwing mechanics.
- Small tweaks to block hit points system and setting of the block mass so they make more sense compared to their physical size.
- Fixed water bottle crazy explosion if destroyed.
- Under the hood adjustments to allow for easier expansion of future features.
- Bug fixes.

Thanks again for the feedback!

notes.title: Update 0.52 Now Live
notes.notes:
We've just launched the 0.52 update to Snow Fortress with some fixes and new features:

- FORT SAVING! In Snow Fort mode you can now restart any level with the fort as it was when the throwing stage starts (ie: When "GO" is shown on the screen). This is the first step in this implementation and currently saves just the last built fort. You'll see a new Restart With Saved Fort button whenever you die or win, or in the pause menu. This will cut the built time to just 10 seconds for any last minute adjustments you want to make and disable the block spawner so you can't keep adding blocks endlessly. We'd love to get feedback on this feature so let us know what you think and if you have any suggestions. 
- SNOW GLOBES :) the level select menu now has snow globes for each of the levels, they still work the same way just look cooler
- New scoring system for Survival Mode, hits to a snowman are 25 points, snowman kills are 100 points
- Fixed powerup (question mark) blocks so they can show cracking like regular blocks
- New Sound FX when the fox is hit by a snowball
- New snowball whoosh sound, so you can hear snowballs whoosh past your hear :)
- Fixes to some sounds
- Bug fixes
- Memory performance improvements

Next Up:
We'll be working on adjusting the blocks so it's not as easy to knock over your own fort when building. Thanks for your support and please don't forget to leave a review :)

notes.title: Update 0.51 Now Live
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the great feedback and reviews. We're glad to hear players are enjoying Snow Fortress! The 0.51 update is now live and offers mostly tweaks and fixes but also adds in a few things based on feedback we have received.

- 3 NEW snow fort levels
- Fix to snowman running away
- Added snowman hat flying up to signal their death (it was hard to tell sometimes if a snowman was killed when they were hidden behind a fort)
- Increased some build times especially in earlier levels
- Changed shield interaction so it can be held any way you want
- Beating the last level in snow fort mode gives you the metal slingshot in survival mode
- Water bottle is refilled during rebuild phase
- Adjusted table and lever position based on your play space
- Minor bug fixes

Here's what we're working on for the next updates:

- Save your last fort so you don't have to keep rebuilding it
- New enemy type
- New weapon (snowball cannon)

Thanks for your support!
